lines: It floated in the night
The moon, like a jellyfish, burst
If I peek behind the bus stop
That summer you are in my mind
Only
Torii, dry clouds, the scent of summer brushes my cheek
Until I become an adult, I stay stretched out as I am
When play tires me, I’ll look at the sky behind the bus stop
Soon even summer will fade
Surely, surely I’ll remember
Growing up still unable to catch up
Night blooms in your pocket
If I can’t say it, I am alone
That’s fine, I’ve already given up
Only
Midsummer, dry clouds, mountain cherry‑sea, rusted sign
Inside my memory the scent of summer always lingers
A photograph is just a piece of paper
A memory is merely dust
Because I don’t understand that, I keep my mouth shut
Your lingering presence constantly presses on my memory, a single summer stone
I grew up looking down
I can’t catch up, only you are clear
I climbed the slope still unable to speak
Night blossoms on our shadows
I grew up looking down
Clap your hands as you wish
We ascend the hill where the sun sets
Our shadows
I grew up still unable to catch up
Night blooms in your pocket
Even if we can’t say it, we are one
That’s fine, now
I’m chewing on your memories
Only
